content: The PTFE washers are in the Belts, Exp. joints (Gen 2) bag. Same with the 10mm spacer.
Instructions say "new expansion joint (8x)" but there is no "new" in front of the expansion joint screws. There are new expansion joint screws in the kit, don't use the old ones.

replies.content: Thanks for this comment, I was just wondering about the same thing as doing the upgrade. Probably saved me a headache down the line. Cheers!

content: Expansion joint screws one of them got busted and they don't give you any additional/replacements so I am boned now

If you are doing upgrading C1+ to INDX with GEN2 upgrade the new expansion Joints (Gen 2) can be found in:
"INDX base" large box -> small cardboard box "UPGRADE" with a print "C1+ to C1+ (Gen 2) INDX"

Dear Sir/Madam,

During the upgrade from Core One+ to Core One+ (GEN2), it turned out that one of the screws, the Expansion joint screw (8x) for securing the heatbed, was not threaded! As a correction, I threaded the screw myself with M3 thread. There was no spare part present in the supplied bag that I could fall back on.

I would advise checking this beforehand, as not everyone has the ability to cut threads themselves.
Otherwise, the update went well and everything worked properly right from the start. Test prints are currently being made to compare with the pre-update situation. The first results look good. The printer is also running much more quietly.

Regards,
Theo.

replies.content: Me too, no thread on one of them.😖 Why did they put exact number of such crucial screw?
